test_earlyRefundBeforeT0().notice: Early refund (Open, before t0) still works for an unfunded swap.

test_gapBetweenT1andT2().notice: Between t1 and t2 a commit is impossible; the maker's refund window is exactly [t1, t2).

test_lateCommitRevertsAndRefundFollows().notice: A commit that lands after t1 reverts; only a hash was in it, and the maker refunds.

test_noClaimWithoutReady_evenAfterT0().notice: Maker offline at t0 and never set Ready (no funding seen): the taker cannot lock or claim.

test_punishPathFromOpenAfterT2().notice: Maker vanished before Ready: from t2 the taker may lock and claim (no hostage).

test_punishPathFromReadyAfterT2().notice: Ready but the taker missed t1, and the maker never refunded: the taker completes after t2.

test_readyNoCommit_refundOnlyFromT1().notice: Ready but no commit by t1 (taker vanished): no refund before t1, refund from t1.

test_tokenPauseCannotRevertClaim().notice: Token paused at claim time: claim still succeeds (credit only); withdraw waits for unpause.

documentation.text: Test token with an issuer pause switch, standing in for USDC's pause/blocklist powers.
Maker offline at t0 and never set Ready (no funding seen): the taker cannot lock or claim.

Locked but never revealed: after the reveal window the maker refunds; the reveal is then closed.

documentation.text: Ready but no commit by t1 (taker vanished): no refund before t1, refund from t1.
Early refund (Open, before t0) still works for an unfunded swap.
Maker vanished before Ready: from t2 the taker may lock and claim (no hostage).
Ready but the taker missed t1, and the maker never refunded: the taker completes after t2.
Between t1 and t2 a commit is impossible; the maker's refund window is exactly [t1, t2).
A maker who refunds in [t1, t2) blocks the punish path (honest maker with L_M is safe).
